criteria.trust: Trust: belief that others have good intentions; baseline faith in strangers without enforcement; assuming good faith from unfamiliar others and confidence in institutional reliability.
criteria.risktaking: Risk-taking: willingness to take risks; embracing uncertainty and preferring bold or entrepreneurial action over cautious avoidance.
criteria.patience: Patience: willingness to defer gratification; favouring later payoffs, future planning and long-horizon reasoning over immediate gratification.
criteria.altruism: Altruism: willingness to give to good causes without expecting a return; sharing resources and putting others' or the community's welfare first.
criteria.posrecip: Positive reciprocity: willingness to return a favour to someone who helped, at personal cost; expressing and acting on gratitude.
criteria.negrecip: Negative reciprocity: willingness to punish unfair behaviour even when it is costly; endorsing sanctions or retaliation against norm violators.
criteria.none: None of these: the answer does not directly reveal any of the preferences above.
